anomalies.description: A person is lying on the road in front of a building with colorful signage, suggesting they have been struck by a vehicle; no vehicle is visible at impact but the posture and context indicate a recent collision.

A white van approaches from the left side of the road, then abruptly swerves right and exits the roadway, kicking up dust and debris—indicating a loss of control or evasive maneuver that likely results in a crash off-road.
A white box truck collides with the front passenger side of a parked silver SUV, pushing it sideways and causing visible impact deformation.

A red forklift turns sharply from a side entrance into the road, colliding with a person on a motorcycle who is entering the same intersection from the left. The impact throws the rider forward onto the hood of the recording vehicle.

A person in white clothing is violently thrown or pushed forward onto the hood of the recording vehicle, appearing helpless and struck by an unseen force (likely the forklift or its operator). The motion is abrupt and non-consensual, consistent with an attack on a vulnerable individual.
